milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The pink bed head is placed at spawn-relative (11, 1, 8) inside the house. The player must navigate close to the bed (within 5 blocks, achievable from the doorway at z=5 which is 3 blocks away) and face toward it (within 60°). This correctly models 'player has found and is looking at the pink bed' without requiring them to stand on top of it.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=mob) to verify a zombie is inside the house. The house structure spans x=[8,14], z=[5,11], y=[0,4] in spawn-relative coordinates. The box covers the full enclosed house volume. The zombie starts outside at (11, 0, 2) — well south of the house — so this rule only triggers if the player has actively lured the zombie through the door into the house. On Easy difficulty zombies cannot break doors, so once the door is closed with the zombie inside, it is effectively trapped. While we cannot directly verify door state, the zombie being inside the fully-enclosed structure is a strong proxy for being trapped.
